notes:
- The very first launch after installing now shows a single button with a progress bar while the icons
  are downloaded, instead of a ribbon full of blank squares. It happens once, and it says so.
- Icons appear far sooner on every launch after that: they are prepared once and kept ready on your
  computer instead of being rebuilt each time Excel opens.
- Fixed a start that could leave the large buttons with no icons at all until Excel was restarted.
- Notifications now has its own place on the ribbon, and the Fuel menu has an icon.
- The unfinished buttons that sat under "Coming soon" have been taken off the ribbon until they do
  something.
